_readme: Projects section. `domain` is the primary filter category; `secondaryDomains` add extra badges and filter matches. `highlights` render as the 'key decisions' list in the expandable case study. Links: set `demo` / `repo` / `writeup` URLs or delete the keys you don't need. `image` / `imageAlt` point at ./public/projects/<id>.png and are dropped by the loader until that file exists, so a card stays text-only until you add a screenshot; prefer a shot of the product doing its job over a landing page. `tier` sets visual weight, not order: "flagship" renders a full-width card, "standard" a card in the grid, "compact" a single expandable row. Keep flagships to two or three, since the whole point of the tier is that most projects are not one.
label: featured work
heading: Work that shipped.

items.title: Tara LEVEL UP!
items.hook: Gamified quests checked by an on-device LLM, fully offline.
items.problem: Habit and motivation apps lean on the honor system or cloud AI that needs a live connection.
items.role: Built from scratch in 21 hours with team BOOM TARA TARA G at the AppBuildersPH Hackathon 2026.
highlights: A local LLM verifies each finished task from a photo, a voice note or a short quiz, entirely on the phone.
XP is awarded under fixed rules, and the leaderboard is recomputed server-side to stop cheating.
Multimodal inference runs fully offline, with no signal required.
items.results: Built in 21 hours at the AppBuildersPH Hackathon 2026 (SM Makati, October 2026), running multimodal AI fully offline on the phone.

items.title: Usapp
items.hook: End-to-end encrypted messaging on iOS and Android, and the push-notification backbone for every other company product.
items.problem: Users needed private messaging where the server itself cannot read message content.
items.role: Sole developer & architect: mobile client, distributed backend microservices, deployment pipeline, and production server operations, all built and run single-handedly.
highlights: End-to-end encryption with client-side keys, so the server never sees message content.
Passwordless OTP sign-in with revocable device sessions.
WebSocket delivery coordinated through Redis across gateway instances.
A partner API for outside organizations.
Full CI/CD pipeline with automated security scanning and signed artifacts.
items.results: Live on iOS and Android · adopted as the push-notification backbone for every other company product.

items.title: Real-Time Trade Blotter
items.hook: Every trade booking, amendment and cancellation reaches every user instantly and correctly.
items.problem: A trading platform assessment needed a real-time blotter where every trade booking, amendment and cancellation reaches all users instantly and correctly.
items.role: Built end to end in about a week with Claude Code, documented in an AI usage report and prompt log.
highlights: Exact decimal prices, never floating point.
A database-enforced audit trail of every change.
Optimistic concurrency, so two users cannot silently overwrite each other's amendment.
Keyset pagination for large blotters.
items.results: Deployed to AWS behind nginx with TLS · 325 unit, 39 integration and 10 end-to-end tests · load-test p95 of 209 ms.

items.title: JMS E-Talyer
items.hook: Offline-capable shop management for multi-branch automotive service, live on a server I operate.
items.problem: Multi-branch automotive shops needed shared inventory, sales and service records that stay accurate even when a branch goes offline.
items.role: Sole developer, owner & maintainer: application, DevSecOps pipeline, and a self-provisioned VPS I secure, manage and operate myself.
highlights: Offline-capable PWA with barcode scanning.
Server-authoritative conflict resolution replays orders made offline safely on reconnect.
400+ backend tests and security scanning gate every release.
Self-provisioned and self-managed VPS: provisioning, deployment, monitoring and maintenance owned end to end.
Layered security scanning: static analysis, dependency auditing, secret scanning across full git history, dynamic testing, and container vulnerability scanning.
Hardened container runtime: multi-stage builds, production-only dependencies, non-root user, correct signal handling, health checks.
Manual-gated deployments with branch and environment guards; secrets injected at runtime with no credentials written to disk.
items.results: Live in production on a server I operate · 400+ backend tests · security scanning gates every release.

items.title: YouFlow
items.hook: AI-native Kanban where AI agents work the board with one user's exact permissions.
items.problem: Teams working with AI agents had no safe way to let agents act on their work.
items.role: Sole developer: built the platform end to end at YouCode Technologies.
highlights: An MCP server where each AI agent acts with one user's exact permissions.
AI estimates are held behind a supervisor approval gate, so unverified numbers never reach management reports.
An append-only audit log records every action.
Automated end-of-day reports: a scheduled job compiles each workspace's finished work and delivers it to management over SMS or email at a set local time.
items.results: Agents do real work while unverified numbers never reach management reports. The team tracks YouFlow's own development inside YouFlow.

items.title: YouGuard Master Bridge Server
items.hook: One edge service that keeps attendance and security events through site network outages.
items.problem: Attendance and security events had to survive site network outages, and two separate bridges each handled only one hardware type.
items.role: Sole developer: designed and built the edge service and its web admin console end to end.
highlights: One Go service with an adapter per hardware family replaced two single-purpose bridges.
Every event is written to disk before sending; unacknowledged events replay oldest first on reconnect.
RTSP camera feeds stream to a live WebRTC video wall.
All cloud traffic is outbound-initiated, so sites need no inbound firewall openings; ships its own admin console and live video wall.
items.results: Deployed on customer sites: events are buffered through outages instead of lost, with one integration path for all hardware.

items.title: YouCode HRIS
items.hook: Per-client HR platform covering the full employee lifecycle: hiring to payroll to compliance.
items.problem: Organisations, both government and private, needed one system to run their entire HR operation, delivered as an isolated per-client instance whose data never mixes with any other client's.
items.role: Sole developer: built the product end to end at YouCode Technologies.
highlights: Covers the full employee lifecycle: onboarding, time & attendance, leave, payroll, performance, recruitment, training, records and compliance.
Client-specific behaviour (branding, leave policies, single sign-on) is configured by admins in-app, so one product serves many organisations with no code changes.
Access is governed by a permission model tied to each organisation's own hierarchy: a person can only ever delegate a subset of the access they hold.
Shipped as a self-contained, isolated deployment per client: no shared multi-client data store.
items.results: In production as a per-client system for government and private-sector organisations. Architecture, structure and stack withheld under NDA.

items.title: Civic Super App Platform
items.hook: White-label super-app that lets a city run its own branded resident app: three cities live.
items.problem: Every local government wanted its own citizen app and admin consoles, but building one per city doesn't scale. The design mandate: every per-city difference is data, never code.
items.role: Sole developer: resident mobile app, the city and platform web consoles, and the backend, end to end.
highlights: One platform serves many cities: a new city is onboarded through configuration and content, not a code branch.
Resident app: government services, 311 issue reporting, emergency SOS, news, tourism, transport, evacuation centres and a digital ID, usable offline.
A city console for staff (content, maps, dispatch, alerts, submission queues) plus a separate platform console for operating the whole fleet of cities.
Live emergency dispatch on a real-time command map, and targeted alerts with per-recipient delivery tracking.
items.results: Live for three cities: MyDasma (Dasmariñas), MySorsogon (Sorsogon City) and MyLegazpi (Legazpi), with new cities added by configuration alone. Internal architecture and stack withheld under NDA.

items.title: Offline-First Learning Platform
items.hook: An LMS that keeps working with no signal: offline exams, lessons and verifiable credentials.
items.problem: Large, distributed organisations needed to train and test thousands of learners on modest phones over unreliable networks, where a dropped connection must never lose a learner's work.
items.role: Sole developer: built the platform end to end at YouCode Technologies.
highlights: Computer-based testing runs entirely on the device and syncs answers back when a connection returns: nothing is lost to a dropped signal.
Offline course player for reading and studying lessons, including video, with no connection.
Verifiable micro-credentials anyone can check through a public verification portal.
Bulk onboarding of thousands of learners processed in the background, so large imports never stall or time out.
items.results: Built for large, distributed organisations with thousands of concurrent learners on unreliable networks. Implementation details withheld under NDA.

items.title: PeraPlano
items.hook: Privacy-first Android budgeting that tracks spending from your transaction notifications.
items.problem: Manual expense logging is high-friction and most budgeting apps expose sensitive financial data. Users needed private tracking that updates itself.
items.role: Sole developer: Android app, encryption model, and notification-derived transaction tracking.
highlights: Encrypted user financial data: privacy-by-design for sensitive personal records.
Derives income and expense tracking from transaction push notifications, minimising manual input.
Daily, monthly and annual budgeting and savings goals with threshold alerts.
Roadmap includes optional premium features via in-app purchases.
items.results: In development · free-to-use · privacy-by-design · tracking derived from transaction push notifications.

items.title: Kalusugapp
items.hook: Digital health records and scheduling for rural clinics.
items.problem: Rural clinics relied on paper records and manual scheduling, limiting record accessibility and efficiency for underserved communities.
items.role: Capstone project for the BS in Information Technology at Mindoro State University.
highlights: Digital patient records replacing paper-based systems.
Appointment scheduling and management.
Built for low-resource clinic environments.
items.results: Deployed at the Victoria Municipal Health Office · digital records replacing paper.

items.title: GeneSys
items.hook: Game-based learning platform for General Biology: teachers host quiz rooms, students join with a code.
items.problem: Lecture-driven biology instruction leaves Filipino senior-high STEM students disengaged and struggling to retain complex topics like genetics, evolution and homeostasis.
items.role: Sole developer: full-stack platform (teacher dashboard, student quiz engine, backend and deployment), built for a Grade-12 research study.
highlights: Room-based model: teachers build quizzes and host private rooms; students join with a 6-character code, no account required.
Flexible assessment builder with six question types, a reusable question bank, and auto-expiring rooms.
Resilient student quiz engine: answers auto-save to the device with an offline retry queue (exponential backoff), so a dropped connection never loses work.
Real-time room monitoring plus analytics exportable to Excel and PDF: class distribution, per-question analysis, and individual reports.
items.results: Live at genesys.filhmar.online · deployed for a quasi-experimental Grade-12 STEM study (Puerto Galera NHS, AY 2025 to 2026).

items.title: Flood Notification System
items.hook: IoT flood early-warning with sirens, warning lights, and SMS alerts.
items.problem: Flood-prone communities needed early warning that conveys not just that water crossed a threshold, but how fast it is rising, so residents can judge how quickly conditions are worsening.
items.role: Sole developer: sensors, embedded firmware, and multi-channel alerting.
highlights: Multi-channel alerting: audible sirens, warning lights, and GSM SMS dispatch.
Tracks both water level and rate of rise per monitored area.
Designed for community-level deployment in flood-prone areas.
items.results: Completed (2024 to 2025) · multi-channel alerting · tracks water level and rate of rise per area.
